## ee602abaa45a

**Reproduced defect — exact public overrides are ignored.** Target generator SHA-256 is `61b18e7ff22e067fb57aeade25eb946a73f428bf1d4e4e812b15e38471be6a3a`.

Exact call:

```text
generate(
  seed=0,
  sample_index=0,
  difficulty="medium",
  grid_h=8,
  grid_w=12,
  n_frames=2,
  code_a=3,
  palette_size=3,
  n_distinct_colors=3,
)
```

The returned grid is **13×18**, not 8×12. The source passes `overrides` to `gen_ctx` but draws `h` and `w` directly through `rng.randint`, so the exact controls are never consumed. The direct, deterministic reproducer is `checks/audit/ee602abaa45a/reproduce_ignored_overrides.py`; its record is `checks/audit/ee602abaa45a/ignored-overrides.json`.

The lint stage also failed with two errors—missing `RULE_HASH` and no top-level `self_check`—plus two non-probeable singleton enum warnings. It suggested canonical rule hash `9c5ac46b22bb`. See `checks/audit/ee602abaa45a/lint-driver.log`.

A generic override-stage run was attempted but did not complete before the outer execution timeout; `checks/audit/ee602abaa45a/override-driver.log` contains only the started stage. I therefore do not claim a complete matrix result. The size counterexample above is independently reproduced and sufficient to establish the contract defect. No audit-target source was changed.
